<!-- Generated by codeflower-app's cmd/gendocs: do not edit. -->

Restart the code flower client running for the config directory from this codeflower, so its page is this release's: it quits and starts again in the background, with the options it had. Paired browsers lose it for a few seconds; open pages reconnect and offer to reload.

Sandboxes started in a terminal or a batch job keep running. Those the client started from its page stop when it quits, so with any running, restart asks for --force, which first asks their working chats to wrap up (at most 10 minutes) and stops them. With no client running, it starts one.


## Usage

```sh
codeflower client restart [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config string` |  | config directory of the client (or set $CODEFLOWER_CONFIG; default ~/.codeflower) |
| `--force` |  | also restart a client running sandboxes it started, which stop after their chats wrap up |
